title: 第17章 乱中取栗第18章 传承
slug: 丹尊至上第391章驿站交接
content_zh:
盆地之内，杀机与死寂，在一瞬间被熊霸天那如同陨石天降般的登场，彻底撕碎！
“轰——隆！”
大地，在哀鸣！
熊霸天那小山般的身躯，裹挟着万钧之势，精准而霸道地砸落在影杀宗那群黑衣杀手的面前。
恐怖的冲击力，化作肉眼可见的土黄色气浪，向着四面八方疯狂席卷！
地面，如同脆弱的蛛网般，寸寸龟裂！
离得最近的几名影杀成员，甚至来不及发出一声惨叫，便被这股无可抗拒的巨力震得骨断筋折，口喷鲜血，如同断了线的风筝般倒飞出去！
原本由他们精心布置的、散发着妖异血光的“血祭大阵”
，在这绝对的力量面前，脆弱得如同孩童的沙堡，瞬间被冲得七零八落，阵基崩坏，灵光黯淡！
“什么东西？！”
为首的那名影杀队长，亦是在这股冲击下，气血翻涌，连退数步才稳住身形。
他骇然地抬起头，看向那尘埃弥漫的中心，当看清那头浑身燃烧着岩石烈焰、气息狂暴无匹的铁背地龙熊时，他那张隐藏在面具下的脸，瞬间写满了不敢置信！
“二阶顶峰……不！
这股气息，无限接近于三阶！
这秘境的外围，怎么可能出现此等凶兽？！”
情报有误！
这是他脑海中闪过的第一个念头。
“吼——！”
熊霸天可不会给他思考的时间。
它发出一声震天咆哮，一双血红色的熊眸，瞬间锁定了眼前这群身上沾染了它巢穴气息，还打扰它“用餐”

的“小虫子”
们！
它人立而起，巨大的熊掌，带着撕裂空气的尖啸，朝着那名影杀队长，当头拍下！
这一掌，朴实无华，却蕴含着镇压山岳的恐怖力量！
“结阵！
血影杀阵！”
影杀队长到底是身经百战的筑基期强者，虽惊不乱。
他厉喝一声，幸存的七八名杀手立刻以一种极为诡异的身法移动起来，每个人的身上都弥漫出淡淡的血雾。
血雾相连，竟在瞬间，于他们身前，凝聚出了一面巨大的、由血煞之气构成的骷髅鬼盾！
轰！
熊掌，与鬼盾，轰然相撞！
震耳欲聋的巨响，化作恐怖的音波，让远在山巅观战的林莹和苏沐沐都忍不住捂住了耳朵。
那面看起来坚不可摧的血色鬼盾，仅仅坚持了不到三息的时间，便发出一阵令人牙酸的“咔嚓”
声，轰然破碎！
而熊霸天那巨大的熊掌，也被鬼盾上蕴含的阴毒血煞之气，腐蚀得滋滋作响，留下了一片焦黑的印记。
“好个畜生！
竟如此强悍！”
content_en:
In the basin, the murderous intent and deathly silence were completely torn apart by Xiong Batian's appearance like a meteorite falling from the sky in an instant!
"Boom - boom!"
The earth is wailing!
Xiong Batian's mountain-like body carried a huge force and landed accurately and domineeringly in front of the group of black-clad killers from the Shadow Killing Sect.
The terrifying impact turned into an earth-yellow air wave visible to the naked eye, sweeping crazily in all directions!
The ground is like a fragile spider web, cracked inch by inch!
The nearest Shadow Kill members didn't even have time to scream in agony, before they were shaken by this irresistible force so much that their bones and tendons were broken, blood spurted from their mouths, and they flew upside down like kites with broken strings!
The "Blood Sacrifice Array" was originally carefully arranged by them and exuded a strange blood light.
, in the face of this absolute power, the sand castle, which was as fragile as a child, was instantly washed to pieces, the foundation of the formation collapsed, and the aura dimmed!
"What?!"
The leader of the Shadow Killing Captain also felt his energy and blood surge under this impact, and he took several steps back to stabilize his body.
He raised his head in shock and looked towards the dusty center. When he saw clearly the iron-backed dragon bear whose body was burning with rock flames and whose aura was extremely violent, his face hidden under the mask was filled with disbelief!
“Second-level peak…no!
This aura is infinitely close to the third level!
How could such a ferocious beast appear outside this secret realm? ! "
The information is wrong!
That was the first thought that ran through his mind.
"Ho--!"
Xiong Batian would not give him time to think.
It let out a thunderous roar, and a pair of blood-red bear eyes instantly locked onto the group of people in front of it who were contaminated with the aura of its lair, and even disturbed its "meal"
The "little bug"
They!
It stood upright, with its huge bear paws, and with a scream that ripped through the air, it struck the shadow-killing captain on the head!
This palm is simple and unpretentious, but it contains the terrifying power to suppress the mountains!
"Formation!
Blood Shadow Killing Formation! "
After all, Captain Shadow Kill is a strong man in the foundation-building stage who has experienced hundreds of battles.
He shouted sharply, and the seven or eight surviving killers immediately moved with an extremely strange movement, and a faint mist of blood filled the air on each of them.
The blood mist connected together, and in an instant, a huge skeleton ghost shield composed of blood evil energy condensed in front of them!
boom!
The bear's paw collided with the ghost shield!
The deafening loud noise turned into terrifying sound waves, causing Lin Ying and Su Mumu, who were watching the battle from the top of the mountain, to cover their ears.
The seemingly indestructible bloody ghost shield only lasted for less than three breaths before it made a heart-breaking "click"
The sound suddenly shattered!
And Xiong Batian's huge bear paw was corroded by the poisonous blood evil energy contained in the ghost shield, leaving a scorched black mark.
"What a beast!
So powerful! "
